readback: A member gets 500 bonus DELTA MILES after making at least one Spend activity in each of 4 weeks in a row.
assumptions: I took "spending" to mean the activity type SPEND (Spend). If you meant PURCHASE (Shopping), or both, change the activity types.
Any Spend activity counts toward a week, whatever the amount. There is no minimum spend.
Weeks are calendar weeks as the platform defines them.
No start or end date was given, so the offer has no date limits.
A member can earn the reward again each time they finish a new 4-week streak. There is no per-member usage limit.
The 500 points go to the DELTA MILES account.

unsupported.reason: consecutive-period streaks need an event (scheduled) section, which the prototype does not compile yet
unsupported.alternative: use nth_activity or milestone within the offer period
